target_customer: Real estate agents and brokerages preparing listings in the US
problem: Home sellers and agents assemble and share disclosure documents slowly, delaying listings and leaving buyers with less information when they make offers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for agents and brokerages
product_category: real estate listing and disclosure management software

founders.name: Paul Nichols
founders.background_notes: Later CTO at Campfire.ai per YC page.

founders.name: Brian Sloss
founders.background_notes: Later head of product at Lennar per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document workflow SaaS with e-signature style flows; standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Agent workflow habits created some stickiness, but the product was a thin layer over documents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: HomeLight acquired it in August 2020 and rebranded it HomeLight Listing Management.

market_need_then: The company described residential real estate as slow and paper heavy, citing about $1.2 trillion in annual home sales.

branding.domain_note: Used a .io domain; disclosures.io now redirects to HomeLight.

rebrands.why: Folded into HomeLight after the acquisition

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press covered the sale but sources show no brand assets or community.

pivots.why: Press describes the later product as managing, marketing and selling listings, date not sourced

outcome_analysis: Disclosures.io grew from a disclosure document tool into a listing management platform and was acquired by HomeLight on August 18, 2020 for an undisclosed amount, then rebranded HomeLight Listing Management with clients grandfathered in. Funding was small and disputed across sources, so the exit looks like a modest strategic sale of a niche agent tool, but the available evidence is too thin to rate the outcome further.
notes: Funding: Crunchbase News reportedly says about $120K raised, CB Insights lists $1.37M across 5 rounds; sources conflict, so no rounds are recorded. Competitor search found Glide (2018) but nothing dated near the Summer 2017 batch, so the list is empty. The disclosures.io site redirects to HomeLight and was not fetched. Founders' education and past employers are not given by sources opened.
